description: This file manages the installation, staging, and dependency resolution for plugin runtime dependencies within a build or deployment system. It handles tasks such as reading/writing JSON files, managing directories, checking dependency versions, and executing npm installs with retries.

methods.name: readJson
methods.description: Reads a JSON file from the specified path and parses its contents.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes a JavaScript value as JSON and writes it to a specified file.

methods.name: removePathIfExists
methods.description: Removes a directory or file at the given path if it exists.

methods.name: makeTempDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory with a specified prefix inside the parent directory.

methods.name: sanitizeTempPrefixSegment
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be safe for use as a filesystem prefix.

methods.name: replaceDir
methods.description: Replaces a target directory with a source directory, handling cross-device moves or copying.

methods.name: dependencyNodeModulesPath
methods.description: Constructs the path to a dependency inside node_modules based on dependency name.

methods.name: readInstalledDependencyVersion
methods.description: Reads the version of an installed dependency from its package.json.

methods.name: dependencyVersionSatisfied
methods.description: Checks if an installed dependency version satisfies a given semver specification.

methods.name: collectInstalledRuntimeClosure
methods.description: Collects the set of all transitive dependencies satisfying version specs.

methods.name: listBundledPluginRuntimeDirs
methods.description: Lists directories of bundled plugins with package.json inside the dist/extensions directory.

methods.name: hasRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Checks if a package.json declares dependencies or optional dependencies.

methods.name: shouldStageRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Determines if runtime dependencies should be staged based on package.json configuration.

methods.name: sanitizeBundledManifestForRuntimeInstall
methods.description: Removes openclaw-related dependency fields from a package.json to prepare for runtime installation.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeDepsStampPath
methods.description: Gets the path to the stamp JSON file for runtime dependency installation.

methods.name: createRuntimeDepsFingerprint
methods.description: Creates a SHA-256 hash of a package.json to serve as a fingerprint.

methods.name: readRuntimeDepsStamp
methods.description: Reads and parses the runtime dependencies stamp file.

methods.name: stageInstalledRootRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Copies the resolved runtime dependencies into the plugin's node_modules directory, creating a stamp file.

methods.name: installPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Runs npm install in a temporary directory to install plugin dependencies, then replaces the plugin's node_modules.

methods.name: installPluginRuntimeDepsWithRetries
methods.description: Attempts to install dependencies multiple times, handling transient failures.

methods.name: stageBundledPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Main exported function; stages runtime dependencies for all bundled plugins in a repository directory.
